marcadores.explicacao_original: The tubule cells contain numerous irregular mucous-containing secretory granules. This mucus is often lost during routine histological processing resulting in the foamy appearance of the cytoplasm. Nuclei are located at the base of the cells and the tubule shows a wide lumen.
